key_insight: VAE-NLME connects fast encoder training with almost-sure convergence to stationary points of the marginal log-likelihood.
engineering_relevance: The method supports AI-integrated nonlinear mixed-effects modeling for pharmacometric tasks such as dose selection and individualized dosing.
method: Use a neural encoder to approximate intractable NLME posterior distributions.
Establish ELBO stationary-point convergence without requiring exact encoder training.
Use the encoder as an importance-sampling proposal for sufficient statistics to obtain marginal-likelihood stationary-point convergence.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical almost-sure convergence results, but provides no datasets, numerical benchmarks or runtime comparisons.
watch_item: Stationary-point convergence does not guarantee a global maximum, and the abstract does not establish finite-time accuracy or efficiency.
paper_title: From the ELBO to Maximum Likelihood: Convergence of Variational Autoencoders for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling
